details: Bitcoin surged above the $80,000 mark, driven by a combination of institutional demand, shrinking supply, and a decline in oil-driven inflation hedges. A de-escalation in geopolitical tensions within the Middle East contributed to a "risk-on" sentiment across global markets, significantly boosting the cryptocurrency's performance.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $80K as Geopolitical Easing Boosts Risk Appetite

details: Heightened tensions between the United States and Iran have led to the Indian rupee hitting a record low against the US dollar and sustained high oil prices, with Brent crude over $109 per barrel. This geopolitical instability contributes to broader market implications, affecting currencies, commodities, and potential monetary policy decisions, suggesting a "risk-off" sentiment. While the Bitcoin market shows a stable outlook above $66,000, market participants interpret the geopolitical risks as having a moderate impact, reducing the likelihood of Fed rate cuts in 2026 due to expected persistent inflation pressures.
title: US-Iran Tensions Continue to Impact Oil, Rupee, and Bitcoin Sentiment
